tex_content.html:
Remark
[Cut-time injectivity radius as distance to the metric cut locus] ↗ def:cut-time-locus

The infimum of the metric cut times over the unit tangent sphere equals the extended distance from $p$ to the corresponding metric cut locus; both are $+\infty $ when that cut locus is empty.
